scope: Environment evaluation dataset of the Alderbrook App: every delivered account seed in data/evaluation/, as env.load_seed loads it. This is not a Task history report.

provenance.statement: Every record is synthetic. The insurer, the people, the shops, the lenders and the policies are fictional. No record was observed or collected.

counting_rule: Each lifecycle step counts on its calendar day in America/New_York. A step counts when its day is inside the window and its time is before the seed clock. Several steps on one day count once.

not_counted.reason: Policy effective and expiration dates are context, not claim activity.
The time of the loss. The claim counts on its filing day.
When a photo or receipt was made. The evidence counts on the day it was added to the claim.
A line decision is part of its determination or its dispute decision, and it has the same time. That step already counts.
The App writes one notification for each insurer event, at the time of that event. So it repeats a counted date.

The App log of every write and event. It also holds writes that keep no dated record of their own (payee.set, claims.update, preferences.update). Their dates are left out, so the count is lower than the log. See context.activity_only_dates.
Deadlines. When one is after the seed clock it is listed under scheduled.
